tagline.pt: Rock com ferrugem, tempestade e estrada.
tagline.en: Rock made of rust, thunder and long roads.

shortBio.pt: Quatro amigos de Curitiba que resolveram, em 2025, tocar juntos as músicas que ouvem desde sempre. O repertório atravessa o rock nacional dos Engenheiros do Hawaii, Cachorro Grande e Ira!, passa pelo peso de Led Zeppelin e Ozzy Osbourne e chega no nervo de U2, The Strokes e Kings of Leon.
shortBio.en: Four friends from Curitiba who decided, in 2025, to finally play together the songs they had been listening to all their lives. The set runs from Brazilian rock — Engenheiros do Hawaii, Cachorro Grande, Ira! — through the weight of Led Zeppelin and Ozzy Osbourne and into the nerve of U2, The Strokes and Kings of Leon.
